Free 20‑minute call

Let’s talk about what your gut is doing.

On the call, we’ll

  • talk through your symptoms and what you’ve already tried
  • look at whether gut-brain therapy suits what’s going on for you
  • answer your questions about sessions, timing and cost
  • agree on a next step, if it feels right

The call is by video, free, and comes with no obligation to book further sessions.

A note on medical care. Gut-brain therapy works alongside medical care, not instead of it. If you haven’t already, please see your GP or gastroenterologist to rule out other causes of your symptoms. If you’re in crisis, call Lifeline on 13 11 14 or emergency services on 000.

Jay lives and works on the lands of the Turrbal and Yuggera peoples. She pays her respects to Elders past and present, and acknowledges Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as the Traditional Custodians of this land.
